newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Credit Lyonnais Suisse 96 profits up slightly. [CORRECTED 09:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Credit Lyonnais Suisse 96 profits up slightly. [CORRECTED 09:45 GMT]

text.p: Credit Lyonnais Suisse SA Bank's net profits in 1996 rose slightly to 22.5 million (corrects from billion) Swiss francs from 1995's 21.4 million (corrects from billion), a bank statement said on Wednesday.

The French-owned bank has its headquarters in Geneva where it also focuses on private banking. The brief bank statement said private banking was a major contributor to profits in 1996 but gave no figures.

Bank officials were not available immediately to comment on the results. Switzerland is a world centre for private banking with assets under management estimated at some $1.8 trillion (corrects from billion) but few banks publish detailed statistics.
